stem.text: Which flow diagram correctly describes the effect of tar entering the lungs?

A.text: carcinogens come into contact with DNA → mutation occurs → uncontrolled cell division

B.text: goblet cells secrete more mucus → mucus accumulates causing infection → phagocytes attracted by inflammation

C.text: mucus accumulates causing infection → phagocytes attracted by inflammation → elastase destroys the alveolar walls

D.text: mutation occurs → phagocytes attracted by inflammation → causes irritation and coughing
